name: Vanthorpe Tier-3 Accountant Moonlighter's Split Kit
description: A sensible Tier 3 office blazer in charcoal synth-wool, worn over a thin armored underlayer that doesn't quite sit right at the shoulders — the tell of someone expecting trouble. The slacks are clean and pressed but have a deep thigh pocket sewn in by hand, just wide enough for a compact sidearm. The shoes are corporate-standard loafers with non-marking rubber soles that are very good for running.
functionality: Concealment pocket holds compact weapon; armored underlayer provides light torso protection without breaking office dress code.
what_it_says: Someone living two lives and not quite succeeding at keeping them separate.
worn_by: Tier 3 office workers moonlighting as runners
story_hooks: The armored underlayer has a serial number from a CorpSec evidence locker — it wasn't purchased legally.
Tonight's job is at a building this person audited last quarter, and they already know where the cameras are.

physical_description.visual_profile: A deceptively conventional office silhouette concealing tactical modifications. Charcoal blazer projects corporate respectability while the subtle armor lines beneath and oversized thigh pocket betray a second life. The wearer appears professionally groomed on the surface but carries themselves with coiled readiness.
physical_description.fit: Blazer tailored to standard office proportions but deliberately slightly loose through shoulders to accommodate underlayer; slacks sit clean and pressed with a noticeably deeper thigh pocket that creates subtle asymmetry; shoes fitted for rapid movement rather than comfort
physical_description.primary_material: Synth-wool blazer (Vanthorpe standard), ballistic-weave underlayer (third-party retrofit), cotton-polymer blend slacks, composite rubber-soled loafers
physical_description.texture: Blazer smooth and corporate matte; underlayer creates subtle quilted texture visible at neckline and cuffs; slacks crisp and professional; shoe soles finely textured for grip
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary charcoal gray blazer and slacks, black underlayer peeking at collar and wrists, dark brown loafers, muted palette suggesting careful anonymity
physical_description.closures: Blazer: standard button closure (magnetic, corporate-standard); slacks: waistband magnetic snap and friction-fit; thigh pocket: hand-stitched heavy-duty seam with friction closure; loafers: friction-fit
distinctive_features: Visibly patched underlayer at shoulders indicating improvised armor installation
Hand-sewn deep thigh pocket sized for compact firearm storage
Shoulder binding slightly strained from underlayer bulk
Non-marking loafer soles indicating tactical consideration
Mixed wear patterns—blazer pristine, pocket seams show stress, shoes scuffed at toe from running
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional with Tier 5 street modifications—signals working-class pretension with sub-grade survival pragmatism
physical_description.cultural_context: Accountant by day, gig-economy fixer or black-market runner by night. Wears corporate identity as operational camouflage. The modifications speak to someone living between legitimate and ungoverned economy, taking calculated personal safety measures without drawing scrutiny.
physical_description.condition_typical: Blazer and slacks externally presentable and work-ready; underlayer visibly patched; pocket seams show thread stress and minor fraying; shoes worn at heel and toe from heavy use; overall impression of something maintained just well enough to pass office inspection while clearly serving double duty

image_prompt: Full-body fashion shot of Tier 3 accountant in charcoal synth-wool blazer and pressed slacks, standing against industrial concrete backdrop with blue-tinted neon signage. Camera catches glimpse of black ballistic underlayer at neckline and wrists. Model poses with subtle tension, hand near thigh pocket. Cool moody lighting emphasizes the barely-hidden tactical layer beneath corporate exterior. Loafers show scuff marks from street wear.
